repositoryPathsSearched: art/generated/candidates/wave-a-chairless/ (on claude/character-rendering-triage-19kvvz, where the automatic pass writes)
found: All four seated source plates are present in this checkout and were measured here: average-man 710x1653, fat-man 747x1607, skinny-man 697x1658, older-woman 669x1720, every one 8-bit RGBA. The automatic separation has already been run against them — `npm run derive:seated-chairless` on claude/character-rendering-triage-19kvvz produces all four derivatives — and it removes everything floating free of the body and stops.
shortfall: What the automatic pass leaves is exactly what it cannot take: the seat sliver between the thighs and the chair-leg stub against each shin. Two measurements say why, and both were made rather than assumed. Chair touching a thigh is inside the protection band by definition, so a connectivity-based separation has nothing to cut. And no threshold divides them: the chair's mid-tones run 96 to 150 while the figure's own sub-knee edge pixels run 64 to 240, overlapping across the whole contested region. Raising the body-tone floor to 160 was tried, rendered and reverted — it takes the feet entirely and shreds the older woman's shins. Drive was not searched for this one: the wave-a source sheets are in no cloud checkout, so a higher-resolution re-derivation cannot be attempted from here either.
generationRecipe: Take each of the four seated plates as it stands. The figure, the posture, the wardrobe and the framing are already correct and are not being redrawn.
Remove the chair pixels that touch the figure: the sliver of seat visible between the thighs, and the stub of chair leg against each shin.

Restore the leg and foot contour underneath the removed pixels rather than cutting around them. An earlier automatic attempt removed about a pixel of the figure's own outline and the whole foot outline, which is what a threshold does to a contour and what a hand does not.
Return each plate at its own source dimensions, 8-bit RGBA, with transparency where the chair was.
acceptanceCriteria: No chair pixel remains anywhere against the legs, between the thighs, or beside the shins.
The leg and foot outline is continuous and unbroken. A plate that has lost its foot outline, or a pixel of its own contour, is a failed delivery even if every chair pixel is gone.
Each returned plate is at least 669 pixels wide — the narrowest of the four sources — and carries real per-pixel transparency where the chair was removed.
The posture is unchanged. A redraw in a different seated posture does not satisfy this request, because the posture was never what was wrong.

target.aspectRatio: as-delivered: each plate returns at its own source dimensions (710x1653, 747x1607, 697x1658, 669x1720), because a hand pass returns the plate it was given
target.styleAuthority: Each plate's own source file, listed in the record's notes. A hand pass is judged against the original it was cut from, not against a separate reference.
